description: Any held item can act like a Totem of Undying and save the player from death.

mods.name: Universal Totem
mods.description: Makes any item held in a player's main hand act like a Totem of Undying when no real totem is available.

releases.notes: ✨ Features Any item held in the player's hand can act like a Totem of Undying when the player receives fatal damage. Prevents death and restores the player just like the vanilla totem effect. Consumes one item from the held stack when activated. Displays the actual used item in the totem activation animation instead of the normal totem. Works with all items, including blocks, tools, weapons, food, and modded items. Fully compatible with multiplayer servers. ⚙️ Mechanics If a real Totem of Undying is present, the vanilla totem activates first. Only one item is consumed per activation. Empty hand → player dies normally. 🧩 Compatibility Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric Loader Fabric API
